approval.title: Your approval is needed
approval.howTo:
To approve, reply to this message with "approve" (or «بفرست»), or write "approve {code}".
To deny, reply "deny" (or «نه»).
approval.unknownCode: Code {code} was not found. Send /pending to see what is waiting.
approval.ambiguous: Several requests are waiting and it is not clear which one you mean. Reply to that request's message or include its code:
approval.notResumable: Decision recorded. This request is not tied to a mission that can resume on its own.
approval.voiceNotAccepted: Approvals and denials are not accepted by voice; please type "approve" or "deny".
approval.needsCode: It is not clear which request this answers (none was sent to this chat recently). Reply to that request's message or include its code:
approval.needsCodeGroup: In a group, approvals and denials need a reply to the request's message or its code:
approval.forwardedIgnored: A forwarded message is not accepted as an approval or denial. Type "approve" or "deny" yourself.

command.help:
Commands:
/status overall status
/pending requests waiting for approval
/runs latest runs
/stop id — stop a run or mission
/help this help
Any other message is a task request.
Approve: "approve" or «بفرست» — deny: "deny" or «نه»
command.pendingHint: To approve, write "approve" and the code, e.g. "approve ABCD".
command.stopUnknown: no run or mission with that id
command.unknown: I do not know that command. Send /help.
